questions.text: Describe the fetch stage of the fetch-decode-execute cycle.

answer.text: Copy the PC address to the MAR
Read the instruction into the MDR and then the CIR

questions.text: Explain the roles of MAR and MDR.

answer.text: MAR holds the address of the location being accessed
MDR holds data or an instruction being transferred to or from memory
Instructions and data are stored in memory
Instructions are fetched and executed by the processor

questions.text: Explain what happens when an interrupt is serviced.

answer.text: Current state is saved after the current instruction
The appropriate interrupt service routine runs
State is restored and execution resumes
